L7·N3917unmasked layer

L30·N10548unmasked layer
Fires on word-initial fragments of rare abbreviated or foreign "B"-words (b in "bdrm", "Bin"field, "Bh"agavad, Br-"ine", "-M"N), and is strongly suppressed on the token immediately preceding such a B-word (the "(" before "(BHA)/(BAAPS)", "and" before "b)", "+" before "B squared") — i.e. it tracks the position of a B-initial abbreviation/name token.
